article.title: Pinterest宣布接入Microsoft Advertising，首階段涵蓋北美及澳紐
article.title_en: Pinterest announces Microsoft Advertising integration for North America, Australia and New Zealand
article.summary: Pinterest計劃讓合資格Microsoft Advertising活動延伸至平台的視覺探索版位，首批地區為北美及澳紐。
article.summary_en: Pinterest plans to extend eligible Microsoft Advertising campaigns into visual discovery inventory, initially in North America, Australia and New Zealand.
highlights: 涵蓋首頁、搜尋及相關Pin，透過公開競價投放。
使用Pinterest Intelligence視覺及行為訊號；推出日期與資格細則未列明。
highlights_en: Planned open-auction placements include the home feed, search and related Pins.
Pinterest Intelligence supplies visual and behavioral signals; timing and eligibility details remain unspecified.
article.why: 搜尋活動將可進入視覺探索場景，買手需分開評估搜尋意圖與圖片瀏覽環境，決定哪些現有活動值得延伸。
article.why_en: Search campaigns could enter visual discovery contexts, requiring buyers to choose which existing campaigns fit that browsing environment.
article.next_step: 先列出北美及澳紐的Microsoft活動，按圖片素材與產品探索意圖篩選試點，待平台確認資格及日期才安排支出。
article.next_step_en: Shortlist North American and Australasian campaigns by visual assets and discovery intent, then confirm eligibility and dates before allocating spend.
article.detail: 公告描述沿用既有購買與衡量工具，並非要求廣告主另建一套操作介面。團隊可先標記哪些搜尋活動已有足夠圖片素材，以及哪些產品需要比較和探索，作為接入準備。視覺訊號的加入並不能直接證明新增轉換；推出後仍要分版位檢查流量與成效，不能把尚未公布的資格、格式或時間表補寫成定案。
article.detail_en: The announcement describes familiar buying and measurement tools. Teams can prepare by identifying search campaigns with suitable imagery and products that benefit from exploration. Visual signals do not establish incremental conversion. Review placement-level results after access is confirmed and keep unspecified formats, eligibility and timing open.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
